_meta.definition: The process of managing credit card information, purchase orders, shopping carts, sales transactions, and financial records related to payments and transactions.

columns.name: CreditCardID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Sales CreditCard

columns.name: CardType
columns.description: Stores credit card type, consistently Distinguish in this database.

columns.name: CardNumber
columns.description: Stores 16-digit credit card numbers in numeric format.

columns.name: ExpMonth
columns.description: Stores the expiration month for credit cards in Sales transactions.

columns.name: ExpYear
columns.description: Stores the expiration year of credit cards associated with sales transactions.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores date and time of credit card sales modifications.
